abstract: BACKGROUND: There have been 12 documented cases of choriocarcinoma arising in the urinary bladder, either alone or in combination with other epithelial tumors. It has been shown that some high-grade transitional cell carcinomas (TCC), without obvious syncytiotrophoblastic elements, can produce human chorionic gonadotrophins (HCG). METHODS: A case of choriocarcinoma, in association with high-grade TCC of the renal pelvis, was encountered in an 80-year-old man. For additional evaluation of HCG production by TCC, 25 consecutive cases of invasive high-grade TCC of the bladder were stained with an anti-HCG antibody. Immunogold staining also was performed in two of the cases studied. RESULTS: Immunoperoxidase staining of the renal pelvis tumor showed focal positivity for HCG within the TCC and a more intense reaction as the tumor cells differentiated into choriocarcinoma elements. Seven of the 25 cases (28%) displayed varying degrees of reactivity within individual cells or groups of cells. In an additional case, typical syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells without cytotrophoblasts were seen in a high-grade TCC. Immunogold studies demonstrated positive labeling in the cytoplasm of carcinoma cells in a case of TCC without syncytiotrophoblasts and in the syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells in the one case in which these were present. CONCLUSIONS: The findings support a metaplastic origin of cases of choriocarcinoma arising primarily in the urothelial tract.
abstract_ja: 背景：膀胱に発生した絨毛癌は12例の報告があり、他の上皮性腫瘍と単独または併存して認められる。一部の高異型度移行上皮癌（TCC）は明らかな合胞栄養膜成分を伴わなくても、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン（hCG）を産生しうることが知られている。方法：80歳男性の腎盂高異型度TCCに絨毛癌を伴う症例を経験した。さらに膀胱の浸潤性高異型度TCC 25例に抗hCG抗体で染色を行い、2例では免疫金染色も施行した。結果：腎盂腫瘍の免疫ペルオキシダーゼ染色では、TCC内に限局的なhCG陽性が認められ、腫瘍細胞が絨毛癌成分へ分化するにつれ反応は強くなった。25例中7例（28%）で個々の細胞または細胞群に種々の程度の反応性が認められた。別の1例では、細胞性栄養膜細胞を伴わず、典型的な合胞栄養膜巨細胞が高異型度TCCに認められた。免疫金標識では、合胞栄養膜を伴わないTCC症例の癌細胞質、および合胞栄養膜巨細胞を有する1症例の巨細胞に陽性標識が認められた。結論：尿路上皮に原発する絨毛癌は化生起源であることが示唆された。
